data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Xe convert two quotes to USD, timeanddate city time, email procurement with subject and body), but it differs in two ways. It splits each quote into separate amount and currency parameters, and it ends with "send (or save the draft)" where the true workflow says never send and click Discard. It also omits the Mail-tab interaction details (click To, Subject, Body) and the Discard step, and it adds an unneeded recipient_email parameter. A builder could mostly automate it, but the send ambiguity is risky.
